whatsappMessage:
Hi Young's hub cafe Hotel,

I noticed your café & hotel has stellar 4.8★ reviews with nearly 600 happy customers in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile website for direct table bookings and room inquiries.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, menu showcase, aur location/route integration hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/youngshub

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Young's hub cafe Hotel team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a showcase of your top-rated café & hotel experience in Marufganj, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
